tools.name: render_diagram
tools.description:
Render a system design diagram from a tiny YAML spec. Writes an .svg/.png file and returns its path. Never write SVG yourself.
Spec keys: title, type (sequence: message timeline), theme (sketch|graphite|blueprint|midnight|classic), direction (omit: auto-fit; right|down only if asked), steps (false hides numbers), legend (true lists steps),
nodes {id: "icon | Label | subtitle"}, groups {Label: [ids or group labels to nest]}, edges ["a > b > c | label", "a ..> b" dashed, "a <> b" two-way, "a => b" thick, "a -- b" line, "a > b [red]" color].
Ids that are icon names/aliases (client, lb, api, db, cache, redis, kafka, s3, cdn...) need no nodes entry.
Arrows are numbered automatically in the order listed; don't number labels.
Product names (stripe, s3, sendgrid, aks...) draw official logos if installed, else a fitting icon; brand/icon (acme/queue) for others.
To edit, change the spec file and call again with file=.

file.description: Path to a spec file (preferred; edit it, then re-render)

preview.description: Return a PNG image to inspect. Only when the user asks you to look (~1-2k tokens)
